bibl.title: Anonymous Commentary on the Book of Hierotheos

noteGrp.note: A pseudonymous work traditionally attributed to one Hierotheus the Theosmothete. A five-part work of emenation theology, detailing the experience of the human mind in its search of perfection, culminating in the union of the human mind, and absorption into, the primitive essence, that is, Christ.
